phase14_training_stopped.reason: Several training Good shapes now fit substantially (pointing, chin fist, object grip); other training targets remain underfit or ghosted. All six fixed development examples remain visibly failed, often degraded, across four checkpoints. No demonstrated multiseed generalization benefit.

phase14_completed.conclusion: Extra training shows a mix of near-Good fits and severe underfit cases. Fixed same-prompt new-seed images still lack convincing structural transfer. No verified development/generalization success; all274 exact exterior checks are engineering evidence only.
